# KyuzenOS — LLVM libc baremetal x86_64 config (Phase 0–4)
#
# Target triple : x86_64-pc-none-elf  (system component "none" => LIBC_TARGET_OS=baremetal)
# Scope         : pure / non-OS entrypoints + subset ber-hook vendor (Phase 1+).
#
# Phase 0: pure only (ctype/locale/string/strings/inttypes/stdbit/errno).
# Phase 1: + exit/errno/malloc (hook __llvm_libc_exit/errno + freelist_heap).
# Phase 2: + stdio console (hook __llvm_libc_stdio_read/write + cookie).
# Phase 4: + time (hook __llvm_libc_timespec_get_active/utc) + utilitas
#          stdlib murni + strdup/strndup. Lihat §16 audit untuk klasifikasi
#          IMPLEMENT/DEFER/UNSUPPORTED per API.
#
# Masih DIKECUALIKAN (butuh syscall yang tidak ada / langgar kebijakan):
#   threads, fenv, setjmp, filesystem, networking, process APIs, syscall APIs,
#   libm (SSE/x87), time/difftime/nanosleep/clock_gettime-*(tanpa backend
#   baremetal di 22.1.8 / return double yang tak bisa dikompilasi -mno-sse).
#
# Only the generic (non-SIMD) string implementations are referenced: on x86_64
# src/string/CMakeLists.txt also registers memcpy/memmove/memset/memcmp SSE2/AVX
# variants, but those are separate targets and stay out of this archive.

set(TARGET_LIBC_ENTRYPOINTS
    # ctype.h entrypoints
    libc.src.ctype.isalnum
    libc.src.ctype.isalpha
    libc.src.ctype.isascii
    libc.src.ctype.isblank
    libc.src.ctype.iscntrl
    libc.src.ctype.isdigit
    libc.src.ctype.isgraph
    libc.src.ctype.islower
    libc.src.ctype.isprint
    libc.src.ctype.ispunct
    libc.src.ctype.isspace
    libc.src.ctype.isupper
    libc.src.ctype.isxdigit
    libc.src.ctype.toascii
    libc.src.ctype.tolower
    libc.src.ctype.toupper

    # locale-aware ctype.h entrypoints
    libc.src.ctype.isalnum_l
    libc.src.ctype.isalpha_l
    libc.src.ctype.isblank_l
    libc.src.ctype.iscntrl_l
    libc.src.ctype.isdigit_l
    libc.src.ctype.isgraph_l
    libc.src.ctype.islower_l
    libc.src.ctype.isprint_l
    libc.src.ctype.ispunct_l
    libc.src.ctype.isspace_l
    libc.src.ctype.isupper_l
    libc.src.ctype.isxdigit_l
    libc.src.ctype.tolower_l
    libc.src.ctype.toupper_l

    # errno.h entrypoints
    # With LIBC_ERRNO_MODE_EXTERNAL this object is compiled against the
    # embedder-provided `int *__llvm_libc_errno(void)` hook. Phase 0 does not
    # provide it and never references this object, so the archive stays
    # linkable; Phase 1 adds the hook.
    libc.src.errno.errno

    # locale.h entrypoints
    # In LLVM 22.1.8 these are all allocation-free (freelocale is a no-op,
    # newlocale returns the static "C" locale), so no malloc is pulled in.
    libc.src.locale.localeconv
    libc.src.locale.duplocale
    libc.src.locale.freelocale
    libc.src.locale.newlocale
    libc.src.locale.setlocale
    libc.src.locale.uselocale

    # string.h entrypoints
    # Phase 4: strdup/strndup AKTIF (allocator Phase 1 terverifikasi; §16 audit).
    libc.src.string.memccpy
    libc.src.string.memchr
    libc.src.string.memcmp
    libc.src.string.memcpy
    libc.src.string.memmem
    libc.src.string.memmove
    libc.src.string.mempcpy
    libc.src.string.memrchr
    libc.src.string.memset
    libc.src.string.memset_explicit
    libc.src.string.stpcpy
    libc.src.string.stpncpy
    libc.src.string.strcasestr
    libc.src.string.strcat
    libc.src.string.strchr
    libc.src.string.strchrnul
    libc.src.string.strcmp
    libc.src.string.strcoll
    libc.src.string.strcpy
    libc.src.string.strcspn
    libc.src.string.strerror
    libc.src.string.strerror_r
    libc.src.string.strlcat
    libc.src.string.strlcpy
    libc.src.string.strlen
    libc.src.string.strncat
    libc.src.string.strncmp
    libc.src.string.strncpy
    libc.src.string.strnlen
    libc.src.string.strpbrk
    libc.src.string.strrchr
    libc.src.string.strsep
    libc.src.string.strspn
    libc.src.string.strstr
    libc.src.string.strtok
    libc.src.string.strtok_r
    libc.src.string.strxfrm
    libc.src.string.strcoll_l
    libc.src.string.strxfrm_l
    # Phase 4: alokasi via LLVM malloc → arena sys_alloc #9 (bukti: smoke test
    # strdup/strndup; §16 audit). Tidak ada versi custom Kyuzen.
    libc.src.string.strdup
    libc.src.string.strndup

    # strings.h entrypoints
    libc.src.strings.bcmp
    libc.src.strings.bcopy
    libc.src.strings.bzero
    libc.src.strings.ffs
    libc.src.strings.ffsl
    libc.src.strings.ffsll
    libc.src.strings.index
    libc.src.strings.rindex
    libc.src.strings.strcasecmp
    libc.src.strings.strncasecmp
    libc.src.strings.strcasecmp_l
    libc.src.strings.strncasecmp_l

    # inttypes.h entrypoints
    libc.src.inttypes.imaxabs
    libc.src.inttypes.imaxdiv
    libc.src.inttypes.strtoimax
    libc.src.inttypes.strtoumax

    # stdlib.h entrypoints (Phase 1: alokasi + terminasi proses)
    # Di baremetal, malloc/calloc/realloc/free hanya pembungkus satu baris di
    # atas `freelist_heap`; di KyuzenOS instance heap itu disediakan port layer
    # (libs/libc-port) di atas arena dari syscall #9, bukan simbol linker
    # _end/__llvm_libc_heap_limit. exit/_Exit/abort berakhir di vendor hook
    # __llvm_libc_exit (int 0x80 #34) / __builtin_trap().
    libc.src.stdlib.abort
    libc.src.stdlib._Exit
    libc.src.stdlib.calloc
    libc.src.stdlib.exit
    libc.src.stdlib.free
    libc.src.stdlib.malloc
    libc.src.stdlib.realloc
    # `exit()` di baremetal hanya bergantung pada OSUtil + _Exit, tetapi
    # implementasinya memanggil __cxa_finalize (src/stdlib/exit.cpp), dan
    # definisi kuat __cxa_finalize/__cxa_atexit ada di atexit.cpp. Tanpa
    # entrypoint ini, memakai exit() (bukan _Exit()) berakhir undefined symbol.
    libc.src.stdlib.atexit

    # stdlib.h entrypoints (Phase 4: runtime murni-userspace, §16 audit)
    # Konversi integer (str_to_integer header-only + errno; tanpa float):
    libc.src.stdlib.atoi
    libc.src.stdlib.atol
    libc.src.stdlib.atoll
    libc.src.stdlib.strtol
    libc.src.stdlib.strtoul
    libc.src.stdlib.strtoll
    libc.src.stdlib.strtoull
    # Utilitas integer (integer_operations header-only):
    libc.src.stdlib.abs
    libc.src.stdlib.labs
    libc.src.stdlib.llabs
    libc.src.stdlib.div
    libc.src.stdlib.ldiv
    libc.src.stdlib.lldiv
    # Alokasi selaras (satu baris di atas freelist_heap yang sama):
    libc.src.stdlib.aligned_alloc
    # Sort/cari (qsort_util header-only; tanpa syscall):
    libc.src.stdlib.qsort
    libc.src.stdlib.bsearch
    # PRNG xorshift (atomics single-thread + sleep no-op; BUKAN CSPRNG):
    libc.src.stdlib.rand
    libc.src.stdlib.srand
    # SENGAJA absen (§16): atof/strtod(f/l)(+_l) [return float/double — error
    # kompilasi -mno-sse di sisi pemanggil], varian _l [subset minimal],
    # a64l/l64a [legacy], qsort_r [ekstensi GNU], getenv/setenv/putenv/system
    # [TIDAK ADA backend-nya di baremetal 22.1.8 — tanpa model environment].

    # stdio.h entrypoints (Phase 2: console I/O via __llvm_libc_stdio_read/
    # __llvm_libc_stdio_write → syscall #48/#49 fd 0/1/2).
    # Hanya subset baremetal yang didukung 22.1.8: FILE* ADALAH cookie vendor
    # (tidak ada fopen/fclose/fflush/fseek/ftell/ungetc/setvbuf — tidak ada
    # backend-nya di src/stdio/baremetal/). printf memakai buffer stack 1024 B
    # lalu flush per panggilan; fwrite/fread langsung satu hook call; tidak ada
    # syarat OS di luar read/write. putc/getc SENGAJA absen: tidak ada target
    # baremetal-nya di 22.1.8 (hanya implementasi generik File-based yang butuh
    # dukungan OS file) — pakai fputc/fgetc/putchar/getchar. scanf/asprintf/
    # remove juga dikecualikan (lihat audit §14).
    libc.src.stdio.printf
    libc.src.stdio.vprintf
    libc.src.stdio.fprintf
    libc.src.stdio.vfprintf
    libc.src.stdio.snprintf
    libc.src.stdio.vsnprintf
    libc.src.stdio.sprintf
    libc.src.stdio.vsprintf
    libc.src.stdio.puts
    libc.src.stdio.fputs
    libc.src.stdio.putchar
    libc.src.stdio.fputc
    libc.src.stdio.getchar
    libc.src.stdio.fgetc
    libc.src.stdio.fgets
    libc.src.stdio.fread
    libc.src.stdio.fwrite
    libc.src.stdio.feof
    libc.src.stdio.ferror
    # Phase 6: stub remove (selalu -1, upstream baremetal). BUKAN untuk dipakai app C — tanpa FS,
    # menghapus file mustahil. Alasan: libc++ <cstdio> memakai
    # `using ::remove` yang bertabrakan dengan template std::remove
    # (<algorithm>) bila ::remove TAK ADA (ditemukan saat audit §18);
    # setiap C library yang didukung hulu mendeklarasikannya. Jujur stub.
    libc.src.stdio.remove

    # stdbit.h entrypoints
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_ceil_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_ceil_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_ceil_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_ceil_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_ceil_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_floor_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_floor_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_floor_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_floor_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_floor_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_width_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_width_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_width_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_width_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_bit_width_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_count_ones_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_count_ones_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_count_ones_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_count_ones_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_count_ones_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_count_zeros_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_count_zeros_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_count_zeros_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_count_zeros_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_count_zeros_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_leading_one_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_leading_one_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_leading_one_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_leading_one_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_leading_one_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_leading_zero_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_leading_zero_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_leading_zero_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_leading_zero_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_leading_zero_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_trailing_one_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_trailing_one_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_trailing_one_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_trailing_one_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_trailing_one_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_trailing_zero_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_trailing_zero_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_trailing_zero_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_trailing_zero_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_first_trailing_zero_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_has_single_bit_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_has_single_bit_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_has_single_bit_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_has_single_bit_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_has_single_bit_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_leading_ones_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_leading_ones_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_leading_ones_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_leading_ones_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_leading_ones_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_leading_zeros_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_leading_zeros_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_leading_zeros_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_leading_zeros_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_leading_zeros_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_trailing_ones_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_trailing_ones_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_trailing_ones_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_trailing_ones_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_trailing_ones_us
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_trailing_zeros_uc
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_trailing_zeros_ui
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_trailing_zeros_ul
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_trailing_zeros_ull
    libc.src.stdbit.stdc_trailing_zeros_us

    # time.h entrypoints (Phase 4: §16 audit)
    # clock/timespec_get = alias ke backend baremetal (butuh hook vendor
    # __llvm_libc_timespec_get_active/utc dari port layer → syscall #14/#20).
    # Sisanya murni-userspace (time_utils integer + printf_core yang sudah ada
    # via stdio Phase 2). localtime == UTC (tanpa tz database, upstream).
    libc.src.time.clock
    libc.src.time.timespec_get
    libc.src.time.gmtime
    libc.src.time.gmtime_r
    libc.src.time.localtime
    libc.src.time.localtime_r
    libc.src.time.mktime
    libc.src.time.asctime
    libc.src.time.asctime_r
    libc.src.time.ctime
    libc.src.time.ctime_r
    libc.src.time.strftime
    libc.src.time.strftime_l
    # SENGAJA absen (§16): time [butuh __support/time/baremetal/clock_gettime
    # yang TIDAK ADA di 22.1.8], difftime [return double — error kompilasi
    # -mno-sse di sisi pemanggil], nanosleep/clock_gettime/getres/settime/
    # gettimeofday [TIDAK ADA backend baremetal-nya di 22.1.8].
)

# Phase 0 ships no libm entrypoints: every math.h entrypoint is either
# OS-dependent (fenv/MXCSR) or needs the x87/SSE decision that is out of scope.
set(TARGET_LIBM_ENTRYPOINTS
)

# Required by libc/CMakeLists.txt: it builds TARGET_ENTRYPOINT_NAME_LIST from
# this variable, and any entrypoint whose C name is absent here is turned into
# a skipped dummy target (which then breaks dependency resolution).
set(TARGET_LLVMLIBC_ENTRYPOINTS
  ${TARGET_LIBC_ENTRYPOINTS}
  ${TARGET_LIBM_ENTRYPOINTS}
)
